channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbusinessAndMarket, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: The ‘haunted’ housing market’s real problem may be too few people, not too few homes, says J.P. Morgan’s David Kelly
item.description: Kelly estimates the U.S. now needs just 320,000 new homes a year, down from about 1 million, as immigration enforcement slows population growth.

item.title: ‘Long gone are the days where we just provided numbers’: The CFO-to-CEO pipeline is growing but does a finance background always make a good leader?
item.description: One in five new CEOs at Europe's largest listed companies came from finance last year. But the transition from managing the numbers to running the bus...

item.title: The anti-Skydance: How a Nike billionaire’s backing lets Laika spend a reported $100 million on ‘Wildwood’
item.description: The studio behind ‘Coraline’ is run by the Nike co-founder’s son, and its films rarely make money at the box office.

item.title: Billionaire Sergey Brin is building political infrastructure that will last beyond his $102 million fight against Prop 40
item.description: Building a Better California is spending on more than just the wealth tax.
